purpose: Frozen authored RU/EN contract acceptance; no production algorithm or model benchmark

contract_decisions.family: same immutable revision origin; unrelated roots cannot merge
contract_decisions.effective_time: timezone required for new writes; >= max(parent effective_at)
contract_decisions.recorded_time: server assigned; never asserted activation authority
contract_decisions.head_targeting: parents may already have eligible children; preserve concurrent forks
contract_decisions.eligibility: stored and activated; eligible child suppresses exactly its named parents; forks remain explicit
contract_decisions.derived_filter: declared supports inactive/conflicted -> not a current grounded fact; empty legacy lineage stays unsupported
contract_decisions.authority: source and author are reported attribution; owner/context isolation is not per-agent credential isolation
contract_decisions.asof_semantics: effective-time only; recording-time knowledge snapshots out of scope
